scope: Paper-only shadow comparison of a pre-checked harness patch vs base on bounded frozen Observe bundles from the packet store; comparison record written via PersistentHarnessOwner.record_comparison.
limitations: Replay requires a DenyAllReplayProvider: a dedicated replay agent (never the persona's own) whose live policy probe reports no tools and no side effects; raw callables or failed probes record incomplete/KEEP_BASE. The concrete gateway policy probe is supplied by the caller and is not wired by default.
Consult outcomes are read only from the frozen bundle's consult_outcomes; a required role with no recorded verdict makes the comparison incomplete.
Decisions are compared on effective actions (gate-passing and consult-approved) with full parameters; rejected actions are no-ops.
Virtual-book effect uses the trailing frozen window (remove, and reweight with weight_delta only); other kinds are unmeasurable.
CANDIDATE_BETTER is a recommendation only; adoption stays with the adoption verifier and risk-persona sign-off.
